description:
Say She She are back with their latest release ‘NORMA’ - a buoyant and billowing protest anthem in response to the impending and dangerous decision to overturn Wade vs. Roe. 

Following the exuberant reception of their first two singles ‘Forget Me Not’ and ‘Blow My Mind’ this latest release has firmly solidified them as a force for making bold statements in beautiful harmonies. 

‘NORMA’ is an urgent call to action to support the protection of women’s rights and preserving the right to choose. The three female front-women Piya, Nya and Sabrina, deliver a synchronistic and hypnotically unified vocal performance together. The bridge features a brazen and marching brass section that builds upon lush layering until eventually their voices erupt into powerful polyphonic protest; “WE WILL NOT GO BACK! // BEFORE IT GETS TOO LATE…// WRITE A LETTER TO THE STATE!”
